g.text: Distributed KV Store: N=3 replicas, W=2 write, R=2 read
One key's ring position -> its 3 consecutive clockwise replicas
S1
S2 (key)
S3
S4
S5
key K
N=3 replicas: S2, S3, S4 (consecutive clockwise)
WRITE: W=2
Sent to S2 and S3 -- both ack -> write succeeds
S4 gets it async (hinted handoff if it was down)
Value now on S2, S3, S4
READ: R=2
Queries S3 and S4 (a DIFFERENT pair than the write)
S3 overlaps the write set -> has the latest value
Read returns the just-written value, guaranteed
W+R=4 > N=3 -> every read set overlaps every write set
by at least 1 node (pigeonhole: 2+2-3=1)
Drop to W=1,R=1: read and write sets can miss entirely
